name: 49031 · Cassopolis, MI
findings: ZIP 49031 (Cassopolis) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (58%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49031 (Cassopolis) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
43% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
